verdicts.reason: A stacks the copy at the top and pushes the ONLINE ONLY badge and Try It button into a cramped bottom-right cluster about 10 px from the bottom edge, which leaves the frame top-heavy and the CTA crowding the edge. B uses a clean three-column banner: the phone sits in its circle, the headline and subline are centred vertically, and the badge stacks neatly above the CTA. B's only flaws are minor: the phone and circle are a little oversized and the badge sits close to the top edge.
